tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Returns every filter operator and transform operation this server supports, the order the pipeline runs in, and the maximum rows per call. Call this first if you are unsure what is available. Free, processes no data.

tools.name: process_rows
tools.description: Cleans a list of JSON rows in one call: transforms each row, filters out the rows you do not want, then optionally sorts, de-duplicates and limits them. Returns the kept rows plus a summary of exactly what was removed and why. Use it to reshape scraped or API data before passing it on: rename and dr
